implementation_notes: Before you name the integration, name the relationship. Each edge needs two labels: the organisational one (who negotiates) and the technical one (who translates). One label alone is how couplings go unnamed.
idiom_name: nodes = contexts, typed edges = named relationships

Billing    --[ACL + OHS/PL]-->     Identity             (upstream)
Reporting  --[Separate Ways]-->     Billing              (no integration)
Ops       ==[Partnership]==          Platform Team
pitfalls: A map that is never revisited
